[EN] I've spent my whole career in Northern Shara. Seen a lot of fighting, a lot of death.

Never thought I'd see so many groups manipulated into fighting each other. I mean, don't the sikandaris understand what the argons have done north of Kaiator?
[ES] He pasado toda mi carrera en Northern Shara. He visto muchas peleas, mucha muerte.

Nunca pensé que vería a tantos grupos manipulados para pelear entre sí. O sea, ¿acaso los sikandaris no entienden lo que los argons han hecho al norte de Kaiator?
